reasons: The finding is correctly typed as 'missing': the supplied text shows no insurance provision, and the proposal inserts one rather than editing unrelated language.

The inserted paragraph matches the playbook preferred position exactly (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' comp, certificates on request, term plus one year) and is correctly directed at IBM as the vendor.

Placement is appropriate — appended in the miscellaneous/risk-allocation area adjacent to p0192 — and the original paragraph text is left untouched, so this is the smallest edit that reaches the position.

Comment follows tone and prefix rules, states what was added and why (hosting/personal-data processing triggers cyber coverage), and offers the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback; all deterministic checks pass.
Minor, non-blocking: the comment cites § 5.3 while the rationale cites § 14.12 for the hosting/Customer Components point — the drafter should confirm the cross-reference before sending.
